description: This source file implements a command-line utility for updating GPS location data in the Cuttlefish Android emulator environment. It initializes logging, parses command-line flags for location parameters, retrieves configuration for a specific instance, establishes a gRPC connection to the GNSS proxy server, and sends GPS location data.

classes.name: GnssClient
classes.description: Client class for communicating with the GNSS proxy server via gRPC.
